programme.title: E4 - Crowded Islands
programme.desc: On rocky islands off the coast of South Africa, thousands of creatures congregate to breed. Among these, huge colonies of cape gannets dominate. Surrounded by rich waters, they can find enough to feed themselves and their young. But life is full of challenges for the breeding gannets...

programme.title: E1 - The Littlest Cub
programme.desc: Get to know Winston, a tiny abandoned cub who imprints on Judy as she nurses him 24-7. Feel the heartbreak as she severs their emotional attachment and teaches this sweet little fellow how to be a grown-up, independent bear in the non-human world.

programme.title: E2 - Meet the X-Girls
programme.desc: Welcome sisters Xiba, Xyla, and Xola, a trio of starving orphans who turn Winston’s world upside down before gentle Xola teaches him a lesson about friendship. Then monitor new cubs Yasmine and Yara, who get reacquainted after a stressful separation.

programme.title: E1 - Water Worlds
programme.desc: Discover how Europe’s best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continent's rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the water’s edge.

programme.title: E2 - Seasonal
programme.desc: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.

programme.title: E1 - Water Worlds

programme.title: E2 - Human Influenced
programme.desc: In geological and biological scales, humans have only been around for the blink of an eye, and yet we’ve managed to influence the evolutionary path for many animals. Explore the human impact on dogs, wolves, coyotes, elephants, and more.

programme.title: E2 - Return of the Light
programme.desc: Experience the north Atlantic’s intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

programme.title: E3 - Jungle River
programme.desc: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

Las Amazonas: Softball's Warrior Women
programme.desc: An indigenous community in southeast Mexico has had strict gender roles stretching back to the Mayan civilization. programme.title: E19
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇。

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won't find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today's world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.

programme.title: The National Dog Show ('20)
programme.desc: From the Kennel Club of Philadelphia, this cherished competition for all dog lovers returns for the 17th year. Hosted by John O'Hurley, the event features 2,000 of the nation's leading canines, including the world's largest, smallest and most exotic. Over 170 breeds strut their stuff with the hope of becoming this year's top dog. “The Dean” David Frei provides expert show commentary, and Mary Carillo chimes in as an adept sideline reporter for this ultimate canine showdown. But which dog will have their day, and which will leave with their tail between their legs? After all, there can only be one “Best in Show”.

programme.title: E447
programme.desc: C'EST LA VIE: C'est La Vie focuses on the real experiences of ordinary people amid the tide of the times. Through in-depth interviews and observational filming, it presents a vivid social visual archive of contemporary China with authentic life stories. With profound humanistic care and compelling narrative tension, it has earned widespread acclaim and numerous awards both at home and abroad, establishing itself as a benchmark in Chinese-language documentaries. Continuously conveying warmth and strength, it inspires viewers to reflect deeply on humanity and destiny.

programme.title: E407
programme.desc: PHOENIX SUPER DOCTORS: Phoenix Super Doctors is a cross-media health science popularization program. It precisely targets core audiences aged 25-65, including business leaders, middle-class, white-collar workers and highly educated individuals. Centered on trending health topics, the program integrates the wisdom of traditional Chinese medicine with cutting-edge achievements in modern Western medicine. Featuring a top-tier expert team led by academicians, it delivers an immersive, virtual-real blended audiovisual experience through XR virtual scenarios and AI-powered intelligent graphics.

programme.title: E14

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

Citizen Pinoy
programme.desc: Filipinos around the world hope to immigrate to the US, legalize their status in the US, or be reunited with their family in the US after years of separation. In this public service program, Attorney Michael J Gurfinkel explains, in plain English, the intricacies of US immigration laws and procedures, as well as advises of avenues to immigrate and developments in US immigration laws. Just because you're half a world away from home, you can still get answers to your US immigration questions.

programme.title: Kuan On One
programme.desc: Kuan on One is a Cebuano-language digital talk show hosted by Melai Cantiveros-Francisco. Each episode features celebrity guests who converse in Cebuano or other Visayan languages, sharing personal stories, experiences, and insights in a relaxed and entertaining format. It is recognized as the first mainstream talk show in the Cebuano language.

programme.title: Aces Go Places
programme.desc: The Mafia is concluding a secret deal in Hong Kong when the loot to be handed over, a consignment of valuable diamonds, is stolen by someone who left a white glove. Based on this clue, the police thinks that it is the work of the infamous international thief 'White Glove'. Interpol is contacted and an ace detective, Baldy, is sent from New York to investigate. He is assisted by a local woman inspector known for her toughness. They start on a wrong footing initially but grow to be very fond of one another...

programme.title: From Riches To Rags
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor...

programme.title: Gambling Queen
programme.desc: Nan, a gambling goddess from Mainland China who is smart and has extraordinary martial arts skills. She comes to Hong Kong alone to find her cousin Bao who lives there. Her target: a crooked investor and card shark extraordinaire. When Nan's underhanded opponent proves too much to handle on her own, she enlists the aid of some rather unusual helpers, including an overconfident casino playboy, a disastrously awkward stuntman, and a perky martial arts princess. Pooling their various talents, Nan concocts a crazy scheme to take down her adversary that is destined to go down in gambling history.

programme.title: E14 - 最後一次出島約會爭奪戰
programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛？

programme.title: E11 - 江湖再見
programme.desc: 腦洞鑑定類綜藝推理脫口秀，陣容為薛之謙、大張偉、楊迪、劉維、黃子弘凡、黃聖依、龐博等…節目圍繞著當下熱梗熱點、觀眾的興趣點、共鳴點展開故事；火星特工廣發英雄帖正面對撞，迎戰近年最出圈、最有趣、最敢說的廠牌大咖們，真金不怕火煉，一場席卷全網的廠牌巔峰之戰即將展開！

programme.title: E5 - 梨花深處的熟悉味道
programme.desc: 圍繞「一道人間至味，一段人生故事」的理念，由主持人王曉亞接收普通人的心願視頻，幫助心願委托人尋找特定食材，復刻一道承載著思念與牽掛的家鄉菜，並將其作為驚喜送給委托人心中最記掛的人。

programme.title: E5 - 周杰倫快嘴挑戰難倒眾人
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星。

programme.title: Love The Way You Are
programme.desc: It's a romantic comedy between the next door neighbors Lin-lin Chou and Yu-ke Fang, who have totally opposite school performances. While Lin-lin struggles to pass the exams, Yu-ke gets the highest score in every of them. Just when Lin-lin supposes she is finally going to say good-bye to Yu-ke after high school graduation, they get accepted by the same department – department of animal husbandry, the most unpopular department of the most popular university. To fix Yu-ke's “First love trauma” she accidentally caused, Lin-lin tries everything to help him chase back his first love, the queen bee of the school. However, Lin-lin herself also gradually falls for Yu-ke during the process. What should Lin-lin do with her feelings? What is actually going on in Yu-ke's mind? The graduation season is around the corner, this is a story for you to call back your first love memory.
